Interesting restaurant.
Jun 2023 • Couples
Lang Ngon Vietnamese Cuisine is located in Hoi An. The menu is traditional Vietnam but a little over priced for what arrives on the plate. The food was a little hit and miss. The pork dish was delicious but the steamed duck was very tough and mainly the duck’s extremities, not much flesh. Unfortunately, the only alcoholic beverage is beer, which was just unexpected for a restaurant of this calibre. The décor and atmosphere however is spectacular. The service was great and the staff were very friendly. An enjoyable night but a little disappointed with the food and beverage.
